newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Furama soars on high general offer price.
newsitem.headline: Furama soars on high general offer price.

text.p: Furama Hotel Enterprises Ltd shares soared after Lai Sun Development Co Ltd said it would buy 45.52 percent of the hotel firm and make a general offer at a premium to their trading price, brokers said.
"The high premium of the general offer price fuelled buying for the stock," said Sunny Chan, research manager at Seapower Securities.
Furama shares, which resumed trading after a two-day suspension, were up HK$5.80 or 22.31 percent to HK$31.80 in late morning after hitting an all-time high of HK$33.00.
Volume was 1.30 million shares worth HK$41.53 million.

Lai Sun Development said earlier it had agreed to buy a controlling 45.42 percent stake in Furama Hotel from the hotel group's controlling shareholder for HK$3.13 billion and would make an offer at HK$33.50 per share for the remaining shares.
Analysts said the deal was seen neutral to the Lai Sun group.

Apart from its ownship in Furama, the deal is unlikely to give a strong boost to the earnings growth of the Lai Sun group as it has no intention to make any material changes to the principal activities of Furama or inject any material assets or businnesses into it, analysts said.
Lai Sun shares gained HK$0.25 to HK$8.75 in late morning.
